question: Which goddesses are invoked to protect the heart?
premises: Bherunda and Makari are named as goddesses.
They are described as approved by the gods.
The heart is the body part to be protected.
inference: Protection of the heart is sought from the goddesses Bherunda and Makari, approved by the gods.
plain_english: May the goddesses Bherunda and Makari, approved by the gods, protect my heart.
